title: Projection onto, distance to, and dimension of the rotated plane T_0 = q(R^n x {0})
statement: For all n, l >= 0 and every linear isometric equivalence q of R^(n+l) = Amb n l onto itself: let graphPoint(a, b) be the point of R^(n+l) whose first n coordinates are those of a in R^n and whose last l coordinates are those of b in R^l, horizontalPlane := span{eps_{castAdd l i} : i in Fin n} (eps_k the standard basis vectors of R^(n+l)), T_0 := rotatedPlane q = q(horizontalPlane) (the image of horizontalPlane under the linear map underlying q) and P_{T_0} := (rotatedPlane q).starProjection its orthogonal projection. Then (L5) P_{T_0}(q(graphPoint(a, b))) = q(graphPoint(a, 0)) for all a in R^n, b in R^l; (L6) infDist(q(graphPoint(a, b)), T_0) = |b| for all a in R^n, b in R^l; (L7) finrank T_0 = n.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ), (∀ (a : Rn n) (b : Rn ℓ), (rotatedPlane q).starProjection (q (graphPoint a b)) = q (graphPoint a (0 : Rn ℓ))) ∧ (∀ (a : Rn n) (b : Rn ℓ), infDist (q (graphPoint a b)) (rotatedPlane q : Set (Amb n ℓ)) = ‖b‖) ∧ Module.finrank ℝ (rotatedPlane q) = n
